content.short: InCred is an on-chain credentialing platform to recognize and reward contributors.
content.description: InCred provides a platform for organizations to design custom badges and awards and award them to contributors. By issuing credentials, teams can pursue their goals, recognize individual and collective achievements, and nurture a culture of high performance and celebration. With support for multiple chains—including Polygon, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon zkEVM, ZKsync, Base, and Solana—InCred delivers a cross‑chain credentialing solution that helps modern organizations acknowledge talent and motivate sustained excellence.
